title: Siege Lab
description: Tune a trebuchet or catapult with real rotational physics and knock down destructible crate structures across 3 levels.
concept: A siege-weapon sandbox with genuine rigid-body arm dynamics: torque from a falling counterweight or spring drives an angular-acceleration integration each frame, and the projectile's release velocity is derived straight from the arm's live angular velocity and geometry — not a canned animation. Fling cannonballs at Verlet-simulated crate walls, towers and pyramids that topple and collapse realistically, then compare your best score per level.
features: Two weapon types — trebuchet (counterweight mass, arm ratio, sling length, release angle) and catapult (spring power, arm length, release angle) — each driven by real torque = force × lever, angular acceleration = torque / moment of inertia integration
3 destructible levels (Low Wall, Tower, Pyramid) built from a Verlet point-mass crate simulation with edge-support collision, ground friction, and a flagged target block for bonus points
Live rest-pose preview — every slider instantly redraws the weapon's loaded geometry before you fire, plus camera shake and spawned wood-debris particles on impact
Scoring (crates knocked + distance + target bonus) with a best-score-per-level leaderboard in localStorage, separate from persisted last-used weapon/level/slider settings
Share Shot button that bakes weapon type + every slider + level into a btoa/atob URL hash and copies it to the clipboard, restoring the exact setup on load
Synthesized Web Audio launch creak/thwack and crash/thud impact SFX (oscillators + filtered noise buffers), lazily created on the first Fire press, plus a PNG screenshot export
tech: Verlet point-mass crate physics with point-vs-edge collision resolution
Web Audio API synthesized SFX (oscillators + noise buffers)

interaction.mouse: Drag sliders to tune the weapon; click a level card to pick your target
interaction.click: Fire launches the shot, Reset rebuilds the level, Snap saves a PNG, Share copies a link
interaction.touch: All controls are touch-friendly range inputs and large tap targets in a bottom sheet
